title: C4: Challenge: Inside the longer proofs
title_html: C4: Challenge: Inside the longer proofs
html:
These parts are about the proofs of structural induction and structural recursion, and the part “Sets built from a base”, all in this section; read them first.

  1. In the proof of @thm-structural-induction, on what is the strong induction performed?
  2. Where in the proof of structural recursion is @thm-unique-readability used, and why is it not needed for uniqueness?
  3. In the part “Sets built from a base”, prove part (i).
